policies.title: Nicaraguan ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Nicaragua as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nicaraguan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Nicaraguan ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Nicaraguan visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nicaraguan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Nicaraguan ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Nicaragua in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nicaraguan passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
